stem: A supervisor verbally asks the technician to blend held material into the normal lot, but the controlled hold instruction remains active. What is the safest process?
choices: Resolve the instruction conflict through the authorized control/release process before moving the held material
Blend only part of the material
rationale: Resolve the instruction conflict through the authorized control/release process before moving the held material. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
